Queue regression coverage lives in `converter_test.go`: an explicit server `reasoning` value is
excluded from the legacy queue model while the existing `variant` field is preserved.

## Manual E2E starting conditions

- A test account with a bound, online Desktop client.
- A model containing optional context window and thinking effort configuration.
- One session saved with reasoning enabled and one legacy-compatible variant case when available.
- Lane deployments for the IDL consumer, archon-biz, and agent-archon changes.
